entityDescription: MPBC is a leading supplier of innovative, high performance fiber laser and fiber amplifier subsystems to the international high tech industry. MPB’s Space and Photonics Division was born in the early ‘90’s with the development of a number of experimental payloads created under contract to CSA and ESA. These early systems where flown on KC-135s, on space shuttles, on the Black Brant Rocket, and one, the Microgravity Isolation Mount, became a permanent facility on the MIR Space Station. For the telecommunications industry, MPBC provides state-of-the-art subsystems to extend the reach of optical fiber spans. For the laser industry, MPBC is the innovator of visible fiber lasers for biomedical and industrial applications. MPBC prides itself in providing its customers with custom products which ultimately enhance overall system performance. The company has an international reach with a global customer base of blue chip companies in the industrial, research, defense and telecommunications sectors. The company is privately held and self-financed.

entityDescription: ITC S.A. (www.itcnet.gr) is an SME established on 1995. The activities are related primarily in advancing research and development (R&D) in the fields of atmospheric, marine and environmental science and engineering, energy recovery and in applications related to these. Particularly, ITC is aiming at the development of methodologies and data sets related to atmospheric, hydrological and oceanographic processes. Atmospheric model development (related to dust cycle, surface energy exchange and aerosol-radiation-cloud-precipitation interactions) and applications in the area of short-range weather forecasting encompasses the main activities of the company. In addition, model development and applications, are related to several other topics including analysis of extreme weather events, surface hydrology, flooding, desalination and natural based solutions. The gained experience is obtained from the participation in a number of commercial and research projects (e.g. SKIRON, NHREAS, POSEIDON I&II, WASSF-I&II, Earth2Observe, OPERANDUM), funded from various sources (e.g. EU/EC, USA, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Norway, Italy). ITC runs operationally modelling systems for various applications around the world and a number of forecasting systems on a real-time (24/7) basis, providing weather-related forecasts and flood forecasting, including hydrological models for various countries around the globe. Further development (integrated tools) and dissemination of the research results and experience built during the past two decades is the ultimate target to advance the competiveness at the international level. The long-term target of the company is to develop integrated forecasting tools that are cost-efficient and can offer high-resolution weather information tailored to specific stakeholder decision support needs (e.g. local weather information, wind and wave energy, flood forecasting, desalination, agriculture management).

entityName: Leibniz Institute for Baltic Sea Research Warnemuende
entityDescription:
The IOW´s mission is to conduct interdisciplinary marine research in coastal seas, with special emphasis on the Baltic Sea. Four departments representing the disciplines of physical oceanography, marine chemistry, biological oceanography and marine geology work jointly on a long-term research programme. It focuses on observations and modelling of ecosystem changes and their underlying processes in marginal seas and shelf regions.
The research programme strives for an in-depth understanding of the functions of the ecosystem with the overall objective to differentiate between natural variability and anthropogenically triggered changes. Past ecosystem states are reconstructed from sediment archives.
Long-term observation data from the Baltic Sea, collected and hosted at the IOW and its predecessor since the 1950s, are a valuable treasure for the entire coastal sea research community, both nationally and internationally. These time series ensure high-quality data support for hydrodynamic and ecosystem models and enable the institute to analyse trends. In addition, the data are used to support "what-if“ model scenarios as future projections.
The IOW contributes significantly to the sound scientific knowledge that is needed to implement the marine strategy for the Baltic Sea. Therefore, the institute cooperates with ministries, agencies and authorities, at both the federal and state level. The Federal Maritime and Hydrographic Agency (BSH) has entrusted the IOW with the Baltic Sea Monitoring Programme, to which Germany and the other countries bordering the Baltic Sea committed themselves in the Helsinki Convention. Besides, the IOW runs for the BSH three autonomous measuring stations in the western Baltic Sea (at Darss Sill, in the Arkona Basin and Odra Bight) which deliver oceanographic data from different water levels around the clock.
The IOW scientists have r/v Elisabeth Mann Borgese (length o.a.: 56.50 m) and r/v Maria S. Merian (length o. a.: 94.80 m) at their disposal.
(source: https://www.leibniz-gemeinschaft.de/en/institutes-museums/einrichtungen/iow/)

entityDescription:
TEKEVER was born from the idea that collective intelligence achieved through the sharing of knowledge anytime, anywhere and by everyone can improve society. Our teams want to push the limits by building technological products that will bring to reality what may seem impossible for most.

TEKEVER was incepted in 2001 and the Group's development strategy relies on competitive technology development, organic growth and having an international reach, operating in areas where innovative ICT and Aerospace products can make a significant impact on organizations activities and people's life. TEKEVER currently has subsidiaries in Europe, Asia, South and North America, focused on developing innovative technology, creating and distributing products, supporting partners and servicing customers around the world. TEKEVER is completely privately owned and counts on around 30 highly skilled, experienced and motivated staff. 95% of the staff have undergraduate (BSc) or graduate (MSc) degrees and backgrounds vary from Engineering disciplines (Electronics and Aerospace) to Computer Science and Marketing and public relations. 
TEKEVER Aeronautics B.V. is the Dutch arm of the TEKEVER group. Building on a combination of existing TEKEVER expertise and local Dutch teams and brainpower, TEKEVER Aeronautics B.V. is currently fully dedicated to activities in the field of space systems. From Space Exploration, Earth Observation and New Technology development, we aim to deliver advanced Space solutions with unique innovation to push the boundaries in Space.

TEKEVER Aeronautics B.V. current areas of activity include:
Satellites
Achieving economies of scale in the world of satellites is quite a challenge: Bringing innovation, standardisation, mass reduction and quick development together into a single package is a difficult nut to crack. Grouping these packages into networks is another ballgame. TEKEVER is working on pushing Nano and Pico Satellites further to achieve these goals. Small is the new Big!

Launchers
Getting into space is tough! Gravity is a drag and anytime you want to leave you need to take everything you need to survive for as long as you’re there, with you. What if you could send things into space as easily as taking a flight from Lisbon to Tokyo? TEKEVER is working towards delivering launch capability at a fraction of the cost for small payloads.

entityName: Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Information Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunications (DIET)
entityDescription: DIET (Department of Information Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunications, http://www.diet.uniroma1.it) is a department of Sapienza University of Rome, recently established after the fusion of the former Department of Electronic Engineering (DIE) and Department of Science and Technique of Information (INFOCOM). It is a governmental organization under the directives of the Italian Ministry of University and Scientific Research. The permanent staff is of about 65 researchers and professors, plus administrative and technical personnel, temporary researchers, contractors, and PhD students. Turnover of staff personnel is related to people retiring and consequent replacing. As for PhD students the turnover is three years whereas for temporary researchers and contractors it is 3-6 years. DIET carries out research and teaching activities covering many aspects of Information and Communication Technology. DIET has an extensive scientific experience in active and passive remote sensing. It has performed activities for analysing and interpreting data (electromagnetic models, inversion techniques), designing radar and radiometric sensors, modelling environment phenomena. Remote sensing of the atmosphere by microwave radiometers (both ground-based and satellite measurements) and radar remote sensing researches for land applications have been developed in the framework of international experiments and projects funded by Italian Ministry of Research, ASI, ESA and Italian Civil Protection. Past experience on inversion schemes include standard regression techniques, as well as Bayesian technique and neural networks.

entityDescription:
Argongra is a SME specialized in “giving value to geographic information”. Argongra is specialized in capturing, processing, analyzing, integrating, interpreting and distributing geographic information used in management. Argongra clients are in both the private sector and the public sector.
Argongra is able to provide its customers with point solutions as well as integrated solutions. Point solutions such as the provision of specific data or the analysis of a specific situation. Integrated solutions such as the design, development, implementation and operation of complete systems that incorporate from the capture of original data to the day operation.
Argongra is renowned for its vast experience in data capture using earth observation (remote sensing) tools and the like, as well as its intensive, advanced and innovative management of geographic information systems (GIS).
Although Argongra manages a transversal technology, it is specialized in its application in some sectors: Natural resources, Energy, Environment, Logistics and Distribution and Public Sector. Our activity has been developed in more than 30 countries.
The Company is certificated ISO 9001:2008 and ISO 14001:2004
The Staff is composed by a staff of around 15 highly skilled human resources (February 2018 Staff members 25).
Argongra has a large experience in projects in relation with contaminated soil and contaminated underground water form different sources (mining, waste areas, industrial areas, etc)

entityDescription: S.F.E. Elettroimpianti S.r.l. was founded as an individual artisan company in 1987, in 1990 it became a general partnership and in April 2005 it became a limited liability company. Initially it operated in the sector of traditional civil and industrial electrical systems, specializing in thermoregulation, which led the company to structure the mechanical and construction sector. Since the 1990s, with the development of new technologies, it has strengthened its staff by expanding the field of intervention in all sectors of both industrial and civil technological systems. It operates throughout the national territory and has a highly qualified technical structure, both for the design phase and for the production and installation phase. S.F.E. Elettroimpianti S.r.l. designs, manufactures and manages electrical, mechanical and special systems in the following sectors: - Civil - Industrial - Airport - Tertiary The strong point today and in the future is to operate in highly technical electrical and mechanical plant engineering sectors. Our prerogative is to collaborate at 360 °, with our customers, to create technological systems that comply with quality standards by offering technologies aimed at reducing investments and consumption. It is a partner of Schneider Electric Italia S.p.a. in the EcoXpert project (energy management solutions) The S.F.E. Elettroimpianti S.r.l. believed and worked in compliance with ethical and moral convictions and in the fulfillment of their work. Honesty, fairness, loyalty and respect are characteristics that still belong to us today and in which we firmly believe on whose principles we intend to continue in our work. Proof of this is the continuity of service of our customers who have been with us for a long time. The company has the quality requirements (ISO 9001: 2008), an environmental management system (ISO 14001: 2015), a management system (OHSAS 18001: 2007) and SOA certifications
